# PitchShiftSoundEffect

- Inherits [`SoundEffect`](soundeffect.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("PitchShiftSoundEffect")`

Raises or lowers the pitch of a sound without changing its length, which `PlaybackSpeed` cannot do. Use it for a tiny creature, a giant or a disguised voice.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Octave` | `number` | `1.25` | read/write | The factor the pitch is multiplied by, from 0.5 (an octave down) to 2 (an octave up). 1 changes nothing. |
